scope: Targeted Phase 5 extraction from the official Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty Magic Story episodes 1-5 (2022-01-24 to 2022-01-27) and the Planeswalker's Guide to Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty (2022-02-03). Short narrated passages are preferred over dialogue. Not an exhaustive reading.

claims.subject: the_wanderer

quotes.quote: She was both the Emperor of Kamigawa and the Wanderer
"The Wanderer and the emperor are one and the same."

claims.summary: The planeswalker known as the Wanderer is the missing Emperor of Kamigawa.

claims.subject: the_wanderer

quotes.quote: Whatever he'd done to Kyodai ten years ago had inadvertently set off the Wanderer's spark.
Instead, the chip set off the Wanderer's spark.

claims.summary: Ten years earlier, Tezzeret's use of a prototype Reality Chip on Kyodai accidentally ignited the emperor's spark, and she vanished.

claims.subject: tezzeret

quotes.quote: Tezzeret had gone to the palace to try and control Kyodai using a prototype of the chip.
"The night you vanished, Tezzeret used a prototype of the Reality Chip on Kyodai. I think he's trying to find a way to control the kami."

claims.summary: Tezzeret used a prototype Reality Chip on Kyodai, apparently trying to control the kami.
claims.limitation: The intent to control Kyodai is stated in dialogue (Tamiyo relaying the Wanderer; Kaito's 'I think'); the narration confirms only that Tezzeret did something to Kyodai.

claims.subject: the_wanderer

quotes.quote: "The Reality Chip left her spark unstable. The Wanderer does not control her gift the way you and I can."

claims.summary: The Reality Chip left the Wanderer's spark unstable, so she could not control her planeswalking or come home.
claims.limitation: Tamiyo's explanation in dialogue; not separately narrated in these episodes.

claims.subject: kaito

quotes.quote: The embodiment of the tanuki-shaped kami that caused Kaito's spark to ignite. He'd become a planeswalker that day.

claims.summary: Kaito's spark ignited because of a tanuki-shaped kami, and he became a planeswalker.

claims.subject: kaito

quotes.quote: Kaito spun toward his sister. Even though they were the same age, Eiko had always seemed older.

claims.summary: Eiko is Kaito's sister, and they are the same age.

claims.subject: kaito

quotes.quote: Ten years ago, Kaito had sworn never to step foot in the palace until the emperor returned.

claims.summary: Ten years earlier, Kaito swore never to set foot in the palace until the emperor returned.

claims.subject: jin_gitaxias

quotes.quote: He did it in secrecy, and even murdered Tameshi to keep him from asking too many questions.
your fleshling companion was a willing participant, even at his demise.

claims.summary: Jin-Gitaxias had Tameshi killed to stop his questions.
claims.limitation: The murder is stated in narration that follows Kaito's own reasoning, and in Jin-Gitaxias's oblique remark; the killing itself is not shown.

claims.subject: kyodai

quotes.quote: The main shrine of Kyodai, the guardian spirit of Kamigawa, is located within the palace.
The guardian spirit of Kamigawa only spoke through the emperor

claims.summary: Kyodai is the guardian spirit of Kamigawa, with its main shrine in the Imperial Palace; it speaks through the emperor.

claims.subject: tezzeret

quotes.quote: Tezzeret yanked Tamiyo through the snapping light, and they both vanished from the rooftop.
Tamiyo wasn't prepared for the hold Tezzeret would have over her, or how it would sever her connection to her story magic.

claims.summary: Using the Reality Chip's hold over Tamiyo, Tezzeret drags her through a portal and away from Kamigawa.

claims.subject: jin_gitaxias

quotes.quote: "Arise, first of the Phyrexian planeswalkers. You will not be the last."
Phyrexia was her new home. She was a part of it—mind, body, and soul.

claims.summary: In the epilogue, Jin-Gitaxias has compleated Tamiyo, the first Phyrexian planeswalker.

claims.subject: kaito

quotes.quote: For the second time in his life, Kaito left the palace with no plans to return. He would master his planeswalking. He would search the Multiverse for Tamiyo.

claims.summary: Kaito leaves the palace again, intending to master planeswalking and search the Multiverse for Tamiyo.

remaining: Light-Paws, the Uprisers/Futurists conflict, the merge gates and Risona are not modelled
Jin-Gitaxias's kami experiments and the Wanderer's fight with him in Episode 5 are not modelled; his fate there is not graded
The Planeswalker's Guide history (Kamigawa's Kami War, Michiko Konda) is only touched through Kyodai
